title: Developing a Custom YOLOv8 Model for Number Detection on Meters Using FastAPI and Gradio
summary: Carries one annotated dataset the whole way through — Roboflow labelling, 100 epochs of distributed training on Kaggle, then the same weights behind two surfaces: a containerised FastAPI service and a Gradio space on Hugging Face.

title: Simplify Your Log Management: Configuring DataDog Integration with Log4j2 In Mulesoft
summary: Ships logs without installing the DataDog agent: a Log4j2 HTTP appender POSTs JSONLayout-formatted events straight to the Send Logs API, behind an async root logger rather than a blocking one.
